appName: SpeedX Highway Rush VR: Traffic Racer
displayName: SpeedX Highway Rush VR: Traffic Racer
display_name: SpeedX Highway Rush VR: Traffic Racer
display_long_description:
Step into the driver’s seat and experience the ultimate VR racing challenge in Highway Rush VR: Traffic Racer. Dive into intense car racing action across a variety of environments, from busy city racing streets to open highway racing routes filled with fast-moving traffic.

Feel the thrill as you push your limits through different terrains, including harsh desert racing conditions and slippery snow racing roads that test your control and precision. Each environment offers a unique driving experience, keeping every race fresh, challenging, and exciting.

Dodge traffic, perform risky overtakes, and survive high-speed runs in immersive VR. Whether you're mastering traffic racing or chasing the perfect run in endless mode, every second counts. Unlock powerful vehicles, upgrade performance, and dominate the road with skill and speed.

With realistic controls, dynamic environments, and adrenaline-pumping gameplay, Highway Rush VR: Traffic Racer delivers a complete racing experience—from city streets to extreme conditions.

Are you ready to become the ultimate racer?
